name: Market Analysis
description: Comprehensive market analysis covering size, competition, trends, and strategic recommendations

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.purpose: Concise overview of the market analysis including key market metrics, competitive dynamics, and strategic recommendations for decision-makers.

sections.title: Market Overview
sections.purpose: Describe the total addressable market, current market size, historical growth rates, and projected growth. Include segmentation by geography, customer type, or product category as relevant.

sections.title: Competitive Landscape
sections.purpose: Map out the competitive environment including major players, market share distribution, recent entrants, and competitive dynamics. Identify the key differentiators among competitors.

sections.title: Pricing Analysis
sections.purpose: Analyze pricing models, price points, and pricing strategies across competitors and market segments. Highlight pricing trends and value positioning.

sections.title: Trends & Projections
sections.purpose: Identify key market trends, emerging technologies, regulatory changes, and consumer behavior shifts. Provide forward-looking projections with supporting data and assumptions.

sections.title: Opportunities & Risks
sections.purpose: Evaluate market opportunities for entry or expansion and identify potential risks including regulatory, competitive, and macroeconomic threats. Assess likelihood and potential impact.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.purpose: Provide actionable strategic recommendations based on the analysis. Prioritize by impact and feasibility, and include suggested timelines or phasing where appropriate.

sections.title: Methodology & Sources
sections.purpose: Document the research methodology, data sources, date ranges covered, and any assumptions or limitations in the analysis. List all referenced sources with links and credibility notes.
